title: 第三章突破筑基中期第四章苟道神术追来的张家
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 声音落下，苏千凡这才发现自己还是裸着的，脸色唰的一下就红了。
赶忙从乾坤戒中取出了一件紫色长裙，遮住了身上的春光。
李长寿并没有趁人之危，转过身看向洞外。
“前辈，换好了。”
苏千凡将手放在胸前，满是娇羞的说道。
李长寿转过身，饶有兴趣的打量了一下。
紫色长裙的衬托下，多了几分韵味和少女的美感。
皮肤也被衬得越发的白皙，让人忍不住想要吃上一口。
至少要比林婉晴好上不少。
“前辈，不好看吗？”
察觉到李长寿的正打量着她，苏千凡声音糯糯，倒像是一只瑟瑟发抖的小绵羊。
“当然不是...相当好看，让我忍不住想要帮你娶回家当新娘。”
“当新娘？！”
此言一出，苏千凡大脑似有轰鸣炸响，整个人都愣住了。
她只是想要拜师，没想到这位老前辈想要娶她。
要是同意，她这算不算是冲师了？
不对，这还没有拜师，并不影响道德。
“前辈，您是认真的？”苏千凡弱弱地问道。
“那是自然。”
“你不是要报答我吗？也别等到日后了，现在以身相许正是时候。”
“老夫也不瞒你，我是万古无一的双修体质，只要和我双修，修为便可快速变强，还能治疗你的道伤。”
“机会只有一次，我不强制。”
对于一个血海深仇想要变强的人来说，李长寿抛出的可谓是致命诱惑。
他相信真实之眼判断的词条，再加上自己的魅力，应该是十拿九稳了。
“双修体质？！”
苏千凡听到这话，目光瞬间变得炽热起来，像是在盯着一件珍宝。
难怪自己和他双修过后，修为会迅速提升，道伤也能恢复。
对方没有摆出什么前辈的架子，反而的坦诚地说出体质秘密，还征求她同意。
能够看出，这位前辈人品并不坏，那真诚的目光是真心的。
在家族和这一路逃亡，全都是充满了阴险的算计。
除了死去的父母，还是第一次从他人身上感到不一样的感觉，内心暖暖的。
content_en:
When the voice fell, Su Qianfan realized that he was still naked, and his face suddenly turned red.
He quickly took out a purple dress from the Qiankun Ring to cover his body.
Li Changshou did not take advantage of others' danger and turned around to look outside the cave.
"Senior, it's ready."
Su Qianfan put his hand on his chest and said shyly.
Li Changshou turned around and looked at it with interest.
The purple dress adds a bit of charm and girlish beauty.
The skin is also made whiter and whiter, making people want to take a bite.
At least much better than Lin Wanqing.
"Senior, doesn't it look good?"
Realizing that Li Changshou was sizing her up, Su Qianfan's voice was soft and soft, like a trembling little sheep.
"Of course not...it's so beautiful that I can't help but want to help you take her home as a bride."
"Being a bride?!"
As soon as these words came out, Su Qianfan's brain seemed to be roaring and he was stunned.
She just wanted to become a disciple, but she didn't expect that this old man wanted to marry her.
If she agrees, does she qualify as a master?
No, this is not yet apprenticeship, and it does not affect morality.
"Senior, are you serious?" Su Qianfan asked weakly.
"That's natural."
"Don't you want to repay me? Don't wait until later. Now is the time to commit yourself."
"I won't hide it from you. I have a dual-cultivation physique that is unique in history. As long as you practice dual-cultivation with me, your cultivation level will become stronger quickly, and it can also heal your Dao injuries."
"You only get one chance, I won't force you."
For a person who had a blood feud and wanted to become stronger, what Li Changshou threw was a fatal temptation.
He believes in the entry judged by the Eye of Truth, and coupled with his own charm, he should be sure of it.
"Double cultivation of physique?!"
When Su Qianfan heard this, his eyes instantly became intense, as if he was staring at a treasure.
No wonder that after practicing double cultivation with him, his cultivation level will improve rapidly and his Tao injuries can be recovered.
The other party did not put on any airs of seniority, but instead frankly told the secret of her physique and asked for her permission.
It can be seen that this senior's character is not bad, and his sincere eyes are sincere.
The family and the escape are all full of insidious calculations.
Apart from my dead parents, this was the first time I felt something different from another person, and my heart felt warm.
[Favorability: 60]
